item.title: Framed Abstract Figure Wall Art Print, Textured Orange Painting (20x36 in)
item.description: "The Suit Ate the Painting." A lone figure stands against a flat orange wall in a suit so loud it has turned into brushstrokes: red, green, cream, all the way down to the shoes. Nobody can tell where the tailoring stops and the paint starts. Neither can he. Every print comes with a listening card: scan it and play the song we paired with the painting. Printed & shipped from the USA, framed or unframed. Original artwork by Atmosférico FM, created with AI-assisted tools.
